paragraphs.text: The Lady of Otaria , also known as the Lady of the Mountain , is an avatar from Dominara worshiped as a deity by the Dwarves of Otaria and Sarpadia .

The Lady of Otaria was born fully formed from a stone egg. She has her mother Gaea ’s pearly, smooth, almost-translucent skin, and her father Fiers ’s tall, athletic, well-toned body. The Lady’s long white hair flows about her shoulders and down her back. Her voice is low and throaty like the sound of a waterfall. The lady's real name is three words which translate to "Daughter, Helpmate, Soul" by her parents, Gaea and Fiers. The last of these, the name that means Soul, is Faerchae .

The Lady of Otaria was once said to have been a giant known as the Lady of the Mountain and later an avatar . Dwarven legends say she was created by Gaea and Fiers working together to watch and care for Dominara. The Lady was hatched from inside a giant stone egg that Fiers placed among lava vents to heat. At some point, demon despoilers attacked the world, creating the goblins to undo its beauty and steal its riches. With the help of Fiers, the Lady then created the dwarves to defend her world.

The Lady and the dwarves defeat the evil, but the Lady is grievously injured in the process. Gaea begins the process of healing her wounds, and Fiers encases her in half of her original "crystal-lined egg" so that she may recuperate. Afterward, the two gods declare that they must leave to repair the damage caused in the battle and entrust the protection of the Lady to the three dwarves, Themis, Gardill, and Balthor Stoneface . They provide the three with a prophecy that the Lady will reawaken in the future. The prophecy is vague, but details that "[the dwarves] will summon the Lady three times during periods of great upheaval. Each time, the devastation to the world will be worse than the time before." After the third summoning, she would bring the dwarves with her and leave Dominaria for good.

To summon the Lady, each of her three names must be spoken. The gods whisper these names into the dwarves' ears, granting them the duty to pass them across countless generations and keep them secret until the time is right. The first time her name was used was by the Sarpadian dwarves to evacuate them from Sarpadia to Terisiare when their empire fell following the Brothers' War . She may have also been summoned a second time during the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .

The Lady of Otaria received a Dungeons & Dragons third edition stat block. She is a high-level female human fighter , sorcerer , and spellsword who speaks Common, Draconic , Dwarven , Elven , and Infernal. Her familiar is a Fiendish Pseudodragon with whom she can communicate telepathically. She carries a variety of items, including the Lady of the Mountain Lightning Sword, a sword that can summon lightning; a Crystal Mountain Shard, a spell focus that contains all lower-level spells; and Sivitri 's Ring of Power.
